summary: Harden the PH-244 verify_integrity bank-fee saved-event checks: each BankCharge must have exactly one costing.bank_charge_saved.v1 event per version (1..version), each event must be a complete envelope for its own version (source=costing/bank_charge stable ref, source.version, topic/schema_version, changed_refs=[that version ref], posting_event_refs=[]), and missing/duplicated/old-version/tampered history is corruption. The branch now accepts the canonical five statuses: draft/pending/rejected/superseded must carry no cost facts, while approved may be the PH-250 transitional state without cost facts or must carry exactly one complete cost fact set (one SourceConsumption claim consumer=cost coverage_key=bank_charge:<id> amount=gross, one AccountingEvent event_type=costing.bank_charge.cost effect=gross with frozen occurred_on/posting_period, one LedgerPosting book=cost origin=current scope=project amount=gross); duplicates, missing postings, amount mismatches, orphan cost events and stray fee claims are reported. The labor event loop allowlists the PH-250 costing/bank_charge cost event so it is validated only by the fee branch. No canonical contract, PH-244 service/model or migration change. Independent fresh-context S review returned PASS with 0 blockers (HEAD 70e898e, BASE 1f02520); its four non-blocking notes (approved transitional acceptance must be paired with PH-250 producing facts without bumping BankCharge.version; per-charge lookup cost; cross-org forged source ids only caught by orphan logic at direct-DB boundary; draft/superseded cost-fact and cost-event source.version not separately tested) are recorded in unverified for the integration/PH-250 follow-up.

review.reviewer: independent PH-253 saved-event-count reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: SAVED-EVENT HISTORY HARDENING VERIFIED: the bank-fee branch now loads all saved `costing.bank_charge_saved.v1` DomainEvents for a charge and requires count == charge.version, then validates every event (not only the latest) for topic/schema_version/organization, source namespace/kind/id, integer source.version in 1..version, payload.changed_refs == [bank_charge ref at that version] and posting_event_refs == []; duplicate versions, out-of-range versions, and uncovered versions are separately flagged (saved_event_count / saved_event_version / saved_event_version_coverage). This closes exactly the PH-244 residual: deleting a middle-version event gives count+coverage errors, duplicating a same-version event gives count/version errors, and tampering source.version or changed_refs gives envelope errors - all three are exercised by the new corruption tests and I re-ran the scoped suite (19 tests OK, 8 original + 11 new).

FIVE-STATE / CONDITIONAL COST-FACT BOUNDARY VERIFIED: status accepts the canonical draft/pending/approved/rejected/superseded set; draft/pending/rejected/superseded must carry zero cost facts (claim/event/posting) and the tests cover pending+rejected with forged facts; approved without cost facts is accepted as the declared PH-250 transitional state, and approved with cost facts must have exactly one SourceConsumption claim (consumer=cost, coverage_key=bank_charge:<id>, amount=gross, source_id=charge), exactly one AccountingEvent (event_type=costing.bank_charge.cost, claim_effect=gross, frozen occurred_on/posting_period, linked claim) and exactly one LedgerPosting (book=cost, origin=current, scope=project, scope_id=charge scope, amount=gross). Duplicate cost event, missing posting, posting amount mismatch and unapproved cost facts are covered by tests; orphan cost events (source id not a BankCharge) and stray/unknown fee claims are flagged. The labor AccountingEvent loop now skips only exactly source=costing/kind=bank_charge and leaves every other labor assertion untouched.

ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE MSELF RERUN (candidate 70e898e, BASE 1f02520, 7 changed files all inside PH-253 allowed_paths; diffs restricted to verify_integrity + tests + docs/tasks/manifest/report/handoff, no canonical or PH-244 service/model/migration change): projectctl check -> ok=true/task_count=175 (task in_review); manage.py check -> exit 0 (53 known urls.W003 warnings, 0 errors); makemigrations --check --dry-run -> No changes detected; verify_integrity --json on a freshly migrated /tmp SQLite DB -> ok=true/errors=[]; scoped tests.test_v1_bank_charge -> Ran 19 tests, OK; governance tests -> 23 OK; full suite -> Ran 804 tests, FAILED (failures=5, errors=3, skipped=59) with the failure/error name set identical to the known macOS baseline (no new names; 793 baseline + 11 new tests = 804); verify-change --base 1f02520 --task PH-253 -> only high_risk_review_required, no path_out_of_scope. Task facts: PH-253 in_review/owner worker-contract/handoff, manifest=PH-253, task_count 175, 7 files all inside allowed_paths, no canonical/PH-244/costing files touched.

NOTES (non-blocking): (a) the transitional 'approved without cost facts' branch is intentionally accepted indefinitely until PH-250 lands; PH-250 must then produce the validated fact set, and its status transitions should NOT bump BankCharge.version (otherwise the new count==version invariant would false-positive) - worth a one-line note in PH-250/PH-253 follow-up; (b) the saved-event query and the cost-fact queries are still per-charge (the fee branch is O(charges) queries); this slice's spec did not require batching, unlike PH-239, so it is not a blocker, but a later hardening could prefetch; (c) an event/claim whose source id matches a real BankCharge but whose organization differs would not be associated by the per-charge org-filtered queries and would not be classified orphan (source id is in the global charge-id set) - a direct-DB cross-org forgery edge, low risk; (d) no explicit test for draft/superseded carrying cost facts (pending/rejected cover the same branch), and the approved cost-event source.version itself is not asserted (only claim/effect/occurred_on/posting_period/posting are). None of these affect the frozen PH-253 acceptance.
